opening: My whole body has been swelling up.
My belly has swollen up much more than the rest of me.
The swelling, the poor appetite and the weight loss have been going on for four months.

opening.text: My whole body has been swelling up, and my belly has swollen up much more than the rest of me. I've lost my appetite and I've lost weight. The swelling, the poor appetite and the weight loss have been going on for four months.
